title: Sticky Pecan Buns
summary: Rolled cinnamon buns baked on brown-sugar caramel and pecans, then inverted.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Dough
steps.text: Mix the flour, sugar, yeast and salt, add the milk and eggs and knead 5 min, then work in the soft butter and knead 8 min more until smooth; cover and leave about 1 h until doubled.

steps.title: Topping
steps.text: Melt the butter with the dark brown sugar and syrup, stirring, pour into the tin and scatter with the pecans.

steps.title: Roll
steps.text: Roll the dough to a 45 x 30 cm rectangle, brush with melted butter, sprinkle with the brown sugar and cinnamon and roll up tightly from a long side.

steps.title: Cut
steps.text: Cut into 12 slices and set them cut side down on the pecans; cover and leave 45 min until puffy. Heat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan).

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 25-30 min until deep golden; a bun in the middle should read 88 °C.

steps.title: Turn out
steps.text: Rest 5 min, then invert onto the tray, scraping any topping back over the buns. Cool 10 min; the caramel is very hot.

tips: Turn out after 5 min, before the caramel sets.
Toast the pecans first for more flavour.
Rewarm leftovers briefly to soften the caramel.
storage: Keep covered at room temperature for 1 day; rewarm before serving. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
